project.description: The Angular project to configure (defaults to the workspace default project).

docsBaseRoute.description: Router path prefix for doc pages (e.g. 'docs' or 'help').
docsBaseRoute.x-prompt: What route path should the docs viewer use? (e.g. docs)

assetsRoot.description: URL path where markdown assets are served from (relative to the app origin).
assetsRoot.x-prompt: Where will markdown files be served from? (e.g. assets/markdown)

titleSuffix.description: Suffix appended to the browser title on each doc page.
titleSuffix.x-prompt: What title suffix should appear in the browser tab? (e.g. My App Docs)

skipRoute.description: Skip automatic route injection into app.routes.ts.
